messages:
marie: Smoke bring-up for peregrine-alpha-v1 (q5-lite) on staging shows a cluster of locale regressions: Korean honorific suffixes being elided, Mandarin spelled ordinals turning into ASCII digits, and Arabic right-to-left punctuation reflow (commas/semicolons flipping). Anyone seen this trio together? tagging @li-wei @sanjay :thinking:

li-wei: Can you paste a tiny repro + the exact model bundle tokenizer version?

marie: Repro curl (minimal):
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY\" \\
  -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"peregrine-alpha-v1-q5lite\",\"input\":\"\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uc5d0\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ub4dc\ub9ac\uc158\uc744 \uac10\uc0ac\ud569\ub2c8\ub2e4: \uc5b4\ub514\uc5d0 \uc788\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4?\",\"max_tokens\":40,\"temperature\":0}'
```
Observed: polite suffix removed -> output looks informal.

mandarin example: in: \"\u7b2c\u4e00\u7b2c\u4e8c\u7b2c\u4e09\" out: \"1 2 3\"  <-- spelled ordinals to digits

arabic example: in: \"\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0627\u0645\u060c \u0627\u0647\u0644\u0627 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629\u061f\" out: punctuation attaches on LTR side and an extra space appears before comma

qa-bot: quick eval snapshot: ko-honorific BLEU -3.1; cn-ordinals CER +2.3; ar-rtl-punct F1 -13%

sanjay: Top suspects: 1) tokenizer mismatch between bundle and runtime (different merges around honorific suffix); 2) quantization coalesced rare token vectors (suffixes) in q5-lite; 3) detok/normalize change for Arabic punctuation.

otan: FYI the bundle contained tokenizer_v4.0.json but staging runtime still had tokenizer_v3.7 unless manifest pinned. Also saw a recent detok patch altering arabic_punct_join heuristics.

li-wei: Run this tokenization diff quickly:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
new=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v4.0.json')
old=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v3.7.json')
text='\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uc5d0\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ub4dc\ub9ac\uc158\uc744 \uac10\uc0ac\ud569\ub2c8\ub2e4:'
print('v4.0 ->', new.encode(text).tokens)
print('v3.7 ->', old.encode(text).tokens)
```
If tokens differ at the suffix, pin tokenizer in the manifest and rerun smoke.

marie: Did the diff: v4.0 splits honorific into stem+suffix tokens; v3.7 had one merged token. Pinned tokenizer_v4.0 and reran: Korean and Mandarin failures resolved. Arabic still failing.

sanjay: Good isolate. For Arabic, add `?trace=true` and capture token traces + logits around punctuation to tell if logits already prefer the bad spacing or whether detok post-process moves punctuation. If logits show correct spacing but detok changes it, we fix detok. If logits are bad, might be pretraining data or quant effects.

marie: Will post trace and logits here. Plan: 1) enforce tokenizer.json SHA and vocab.tsv in model bundle + startup assert (will file PR); 2) bisect detok for Arabic punctuation; 3) if detok looks clean, run float vs q5-lite parity on small sample to inspect logit shifts.

otan: I can add an onboarding smoke that includes a tiny Korean honorific and a Mandarin ordinal case to catch tokenizer pin regressions automatically.

qa-bot: Filed ticket INF-5301: pin tokenizer in manifest, add onboarding asserts, add AR detok unit tests, run quant-parity job for q5-lite if Arabic logits suspect.

marie: Update 25m later: pin fixed KO/CN. Arabic `?trace=true` shows model logits favor the token sequence with a leading space before comma (logit higher). That suggests training/preprocessing introduced the pattern. I'll kick off a tiny preprocessing bisect to find when it started and post results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
